datasets.file: DataSheet4_A Universal Screening Tool for Dyslexia by a Web-Game and Machine Learning.CSV

cross_dataset.participant_identity: Rello and DGames export no participant ID. One row per participant is assumed from study design; duplicate-vector grouping is only a safeguard.
cross_dataset.pooling: No verified equivalent feature vector across Rello, MusVis, DGames and Opacity. Do not pool.
cross_dataset.musvis: 313 rows but 311 unique IDs and hashes; group repeated identifiers if modeled. Export has 236 columns versus paper description of 201 features; retain version mismatch.
cross_dataset.dgames: 16 derived efficiency columns contain nonnumeric multiple-dot tokens; recompute from original components if used. Auditory task differs from MusVis.
